description: Consumer Affairs Authority - The Consumer Affairs Authority Orders that no Producer / Miller shall sell, expose or offer for Sale or Display for Sale the Varieties of Rice Listed
reasoning: This gazette content contains a regulatory order issued by the Consumer Affairs Authority under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 09 of 2003. It establishes maximum price controls for specific varieties of rice, which constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves the exercise of statutory powers to create binding regulations rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
